description: This file contains internal function declarations, object definitions, and data structures for handling ASN.1 extensions within a cryptographic or certificate processing library. It primarily defines interfaces for creating, validating, and manipulating various ASN.1 objects related to cryptographic extensions, such as extensions, policies, names, and other certificate-related structures.
